candidate_workaround: Enumerate the installed skill package and invoke the entrypoint that actually exists.

rollback: Give the missing-entrypoint invocation zero index credit and leave the existing index unchanged.
scope_boundary: Same-owner installed-skill path recovery only; not package provenance, production certification, or independent reproduction.
